const data=$input.first().json; const categories=data.lighthouseResult?.categories||{}; const scores=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(categories).map(([id,category])=>[id,Math.round(Number(category.score||0)*100)])); const pageSpeed={status:data.error?'unavailable':'available',error:data.error?.message||null,signal:data.error?null:{source:'pagespeed-insights',evidenceClass:'public_measurement',targetUrl:data.id||'https://thebikershop.com.br/',strategy:'mobile',scores}}; return [{json:{kind:'public_shop_seo',status:pageSpeed.status,siteAudit:null,pageSpeed}}];

const ids=($json.items||[]).map((item)=>item.id?.videoId).filter(Boolean); const market=$('Expandir buscas do YouTube Brasil').item.json.market; return {json:{ids:[...new Set(ids)].slice(0,50),market,error:$json.error?.message||null}};

const upstream=$('Consolidar IDs do YouTube').item.json; const market=upstream.market; const videos=($json.items||[]).map((video)=>({...video,_intelligence:{markets:[market.regionCode],languages:[market.relevanceLanguage],searches:[market.id||market.query]}})); return {json:{kind:'youtube_part',error:upstream.error||$json.error?.message||null,videos}};

const map=new Map(); const errors=[]; for(const item of $input.all()){if(item.json.error)errors.push(item.json.error); for(const video of item.json.videos||[]){const previous=map.get(video.id); if(!previous){map.set(video.id,video);continue;} previous._intelligence={markets:[...new Set([...(previous._intelligence?.markets||[]),...(video._intelligence?.markets||[])])],languages:[...new Set([...(previous._intelligence?.languages||[]),...(video._intelligence?.languages||[])])],searches:[...new Set([...(previous._intelligence?.searches||[]),...(video._intelligence?.searches||[])])]};}} return [{json:{kind:'youtube',error:errors[0]||null,videos:[...map.values()]}}];
